component.name: Tidy
component.summary: Keeps your Plasma desktop, panel and system tray clean
Houdt je bureaublad, paneel en systeemvak opgeruimd

description.p: Tidy hides your desktop icons when you are not using them and brings them back when you need them: on a click on the desktop, on mouse movement, in a screen corner or with a shortcut.
It tidies the rest of the desktop too:

ul.li: Drawers in the panel tuck programs and widgets away, in the panel or in a pop-up
Choose per system tray icon whether it is shown, hidden or automatic
Focus mode hides the icons, closes the drawers and trims the tray with one shortcut
Profiles and rules switch settings by themselves: on battery, at certain hours, per program
Hold a key to peek at everything for a moment

description.p: Tidy is made for Plasma 6 on Wayland. It is light: about 24 MB of memory and no processor time at rest.

screenshot.caption: The desktop with its icons hidden
A click on the desktop brings the icons and the panel back
A drawer in the panel, open
A drawer as a pop-up above the panel

description.p: A search field for the settings, rules that keep the night light off, a fan as a new pop-up look for drawers, a click of your own per drawer, smoother drawers, and a right-click on the hidden desktop opens its menu again.
A drawer's settings have a button that puts a folder in the drawer, for quick access.
A new drawer leaves open programs in the panel, and installing from source is one step that also works on Arch.
The one-by-one animation of a drawer is quick and in order, and unplugging a second screen no longer gives a false warning.
Drawers are closed from the first moment the panel shows, and two drawers that open on a click on the panel stay open together.
The drawer that the welcome window adds starts closed, and the list of programs in a drawer's settings is tidier.
The first version meant for others.
